items.say: Hi, I'm Hazel. I build slowly, one stick at a time. Let's do one thing together.
text: Pick one thing, then give it a set stretch of time. We start with ten minutes, and the time grows along the path.
Your screen stays on while the timer runs. Pause whenever you like, and finish whenever you're done. Stopping early is fine.
If your mind wanders, that's normal. Notice it, then come back to your one thing. That's all focus is.
